prompt: R parser #line directive placement constraint vs C
answer:
In R, `#line` must begin at the first five characters of the line—there can be no leading whitespace. Whitespace is allowed only between `#line`, the line number, and the optional filename. Any text after the directive is treated as a comment and ignored.

Unlike R, the C `#line` directive does not impose this “first five characters” placement constraint.
